title: find_index returns on first mismatch
description: find_index should return the index of the first occurrence of target, or -1 if absent. The buggy version returns -1 as soon as the first element does not match, instead of continuing the search.

hidden_tests.test_search.py:
from search import find_index


def test_find_index():
    assert find_index([1, 2, 3], 3) == 2
    assert find_index([1, 2, 3], 1) == 0
    assert find_index([1, 2, 3], 9) == -1
    assert find_index([], 1) == -1
